name: New York City
about: Fall (Sep–Nov) is widely considered ideal — crisp air, foliage in nearby parks. Summer is hot/humid, winter brings holiday magic but bitter cold.
overview: Every kind of city experience at once — world-class museums, theater, and food, packed onto one walkable island.
costOverview: Transit and pizza are cheap; taxis and shows add up fast.
monthlyWeather: bitterly cold, with occasional snow and biting wind off the rivers
